title: Kits
summary: **Kits** are the fixed loadouts you fight with in ChromaPVP duels. Every player gets the same items, so a duel comes down to skill and your own hotbar layout.

blocks.p: Duels use three kits: **Sword**, **Axe** and **Mace**. Each one can be played ranked or unranked. You pick the kit when you queue, from the Play screen (`/play`) or with `/queue` and the kit name, such as `/queue mace`.

ul: {{icon:diamond_sword}} **Sword** is diamond gear with a Sharpness sword and nothing else. Hunger and natural regeneration are off, so hits decide the fight.
{{icon:diamond_axe}} **Axe** is plain diamond: an axe, a sword, a crossbow, a bow, arrows and a shield. Nothing is enchanted and there is no food. The axe disables shields.
{{icon:mace}} **Mace** is netherite with a Wind Burst mace, wind charges, ender pearls, totems and splash potions. Fall damage is on. Mace duels also get jump pads on the arena floor.

blocks.p: A fourth kit, **Chaos**, is listed as coming soon and cannot be queued yet.
You can move every item of a kit to the slot you want and save it as a layout. Each kit has three free layout slots, so you can keep a few setups and switch between them.

ul: `/kit` shows your kits. Click one to see its layouts.
`/kit edit` with a kit and a slot (for example `/kit edit sword 2`) opens the editor. Arrange your inventory, then click **Save**.
`/kit slot` with a kit and a number (for example `/kit slot sword 2`) picks which saved layout that kit uses.

blocks.p: The editor only opens in the lobby, not while you queue, fight or stand in the FFA pit.

The [FFA](/wiki/pvp/ffa/) pit has its own kits. You buy them once with Prism Coins on the **Supplies** screen, and you lose them when you die. They come in four tabs: Kits, Legendary, Clout and Utility. The strongest armour any of them carries is Protection 3.

ul: Use `/practice` and a kit name (`/practice axe`) in the lobby to arm a kit and hit the training dummies. Practice items cannot be thrown or stashed, and `/leave` puts the kit away.
Set your layout before you queue ranked. The default hotbar is rarely the one people end up with.
In Axe duels, a raised shield does not save you for long: one axe hit disables it.

history.text: Axe queues opened with a kit of a plain diamond axe, a sword, crossbow, bow, 6 arrows and a shield.
The sword kit no longer has golden apples or steak, and hunger is off.
The duel sword kit now has Sharpness IV and no Knockback.
The Kits tab opened with 19 one-life kits, plus practice kits and training dummies.
